text: The test's message listener can call cleanUp, but the const binding is initialized only after messageDisplay.open resolves. The open API waits for MsgLoaded; message-display script work starts from MsgLoading and has a separate async execution path. If the loaded notification callback runs before that binding is initialized, the callback reads an uninitialized binding. This is a conditional static ordering concern. Transport scheduling was not established, and no race or test failure was reproduced.
title: The EWS script test initializes its cleanup callback after the awaited message open
